"""Verify SECRET_KEY_FALLBACKS keeps sessions alive after key rotation (#34384)."""
import django
from django.conf import settings

settings.configure(
    DEBUG=True,
    DATABASES={"default": {"ENGINE": "django.db.backends.sqlite3", "NAME": ":memory:"}},
    INSTALLED_APPS=[
        "django.contrib.auth",
        "django.contrib.contenttypes",
        "django.contrib.sessions",
    ],
    SECRET_KEY="old-secret",
    SECRET_KEY_FALLBACKS=[],
    USE_TZ=True,
    ROOT_URLCONF="verify_urls",
)
django.setup()

from django.contrib.auth import get_user, get_user_model  # noqa: E402
from django.contrib.sessions.backends.db import SessionStore  # noqa: E402
from django.test import RequestFactory  # noqa: E402
from django.test.utils import setup_test_environment, teardown_test_environment  # noqa: E402
from django.test.runner import DiscoverRunner  # noqa: E402

setup_test_environment()
runner = DiscoverRunner(interactive=False, verbosity=0)
old_config = runner.setup_databases()

User = get_user_model()
user = User.objects.create_user("alice", "a@example.com", "pw12345")

# 1. Log in under the ORIGINAL secret key.
request = RequestFactory().request()
request.session = SessionStore()
request.session["django.contrib.auth.backends.ModelBackend"] = user.pk
request.session["_auth_user_hash"] = user.get_session_auth_hash()
request.session.save()
session_key_before = request.session.session_key

# 2. Rotate: new SECRET_KEY, old one moved to SECRET_KEY_FALLBACKS.
settings.SECRET_KEY = "new-secret"
settings.SECRET_KEY_FALLBACKS = ["old-secret"]

request2 = RequestFactory().request()
request2.session = SessionStore(session_key=session_key_before)
request2.session.load()
resolved = get_user(request2)
assert resolved.is_authenticated, "FAIL: user logged out after key rotation"
assert resolved.pk == user.pk
print("PASS: session survives rotation when old key is in SECRET_KEY_FALLBACKS")
print("  session key cycled:", request2.session.session_key != session_key_before)
print("  session hash re-signed with current key:",
      request2.session["_auth_user_hash"] == user.get_session_auth_hash())

# 3. After fallback removal, the re-signed session still works.
settings.SECRET_KEY_FALLBACKS = []
request3 = RequestFactory().request()
request3.session = SessionStore(session_key=request2.session.session_key)
request3.session.load()
resolved3 = get_user(request3)
assert resolved3.is_authenticated and resolved3.pk == user.pk
print("PASS: session survives after fallbacks are removed (hash was re-signed)")

# 4. Wrong fallback (neither key matches) must still log the user out.
settings.SECRET_KEY = "third-secret"
settings.SECRET_KEY_FALLBACKS = ["unrelated-secret"]
request4 = RequestFactory().request()
request4.session = SessionStore(session_key=request2.session.session_key)
request4.session.load()
resolved4 = get_user(request4)
assert not resolved4.is_authenticated, "FAIL: unknown key should invalidate session"
print("PASS: session still invalidated when no key matches")

runner.teardown_databases(old_config)
teardown_test_environment()
print("ALL CHECKS OK")
